address: Arrowe Park Road, Upton, Wirral CH49 0UF
address_note: gov.uk's find-driving-test-centre service could not be reached from this machine (no connection). gov.uk search still lists the centre (a 2014 DVSA FOI release for Upton and Wallasey centres). Address taken from a page quoting DVSA's centre data updated November 2026 (passrates.uk: Arrowe Park Rd, Upton, CH49 0UF, 10.9K tests in 2024-25) and matched by drivingtesttips.biz's centre page. The postcode centroid (53.37934, -3.09776) is about 55 m from the given position, and OSM places Arrowe Park Road (A551) way/670885918 beside it, so it matches. The old route lists all start by turning left onto Arrowe Park Road, so the centre has not moved since they were written. Recheck on gov.uk when reachable.

summary: 0 confirmed and 21 likely places (17 roads, 4 junctions): the old route lists (s1, s2 counted once) name many roads and junctions round the centre, and one instructor's first-hand accounts name the Sainsbury's roundabout and a roundabout between Greasby and Upton. Two routes meeting the overlap rule look possible from the map (the A5027 Upton Bypass and its roundabouts, Old Greasby Road and the Arrowe Park Road lights, Upton Road and Ford Road, the estates both sides of Arrowe Park Road), though no road reaches confirmed.
